dws.intro: One number for how fair and safe work is here: pay, rest, handling of worker reports, how workers feel, and attendance records.
dws.gaugeLabel: Decent Work Score {score} out of 100. Band: {band}.

dws.noDrivers: Nothing is pulling the score down.
dws.driver.pay: {underpaid} of {checked} payslips were underpaid (short by {shortfallPaise} in total).
dws.driver.rest: Rest warnings: {red} red and {amber} amber, out of {workers} workers.
dws.driver.grievances: {breaches} of {considered} worker reports were not handled in time; {overdue} are overdue and still open.
dws.driver.sentiment: Workers rate their workplace {average} out of 5 ({responses} answers).
dws.driver.attendance: {disputes} attendance disputes on {records} records; {overdue} were not handled in time.
dws.trendLabel: Line chart of the Decent Work Score from {from} to {to}: from {first} to {last} out of 100.
dws.how.intro: The score is a weighted average of five parts, each from 0 to 100. The weights add up to 100%.
dws.how.pay: Pay accuracy: the share of last month's payslips that were paid correctly (see Pay compliance).
dws.how.rest: Rest and overtime: each worker counts 100 with no rest warning, 50 with an amber warning and 0 with a red one.
dws.how.grievances: Handling of worker reports: the share of reports from the last 90 days answered within 3 days (serious), 7 days (medium) or 14 days (low). Open reports past that time count against you.
dws.how.sentiment: Worker sentiment: the average anonymous rating (1 to 5) mapped to 0-100. A group only counts when at least 3 people answered; otherwise it is left out.
dws.how.attendance: Attendance accuracy: half from how rarely attendance records are disputed (10% disputed gives 0), half from how many disputes were handled within 3 days.
dws.how.missing: A part with no data is left out and the other weights are scaled up so they still add up to 100%.
dws.how.bands: Healthy: {healthy} or more. Needs attention: {attention} to {healthyBelow}. At risk: below {attention}.
